interpretation: All128 sampled rows contain complete phase0d9 with one-to-one legal coverage; this does not quantify missing or incomplete blocks elsewhere. Both stopped and extended G10 branches are represented.

Legacy uniform-d9 substantially changes the observed targets in these three games because it overlays later-phase d9 scores. The phase0 rank tool would reject36 sampled rows if joined to those legacy stored SF maxima.
The current deriver verifies and preserves original full-history input keys before writing. Raw BT4 source/input keys, legal policy and game/ply match all128 rows.

The current writer stores x as float16. Every sampled raw input_tensor_key changes when recomputed from stored x, while stored x equals the exact float16 cast of original encoded x and source/root fingerprints remain matched. This is expected storage quantization, not evidence of data corruption.
Bare game_id/ply collides35times between the two runs. Source namespace is essential; root-position source_key is also not a unique full-history or physical-row identity.

Current writer shuffle was exercised exactly on separate64-row diagnostic shards with PCG64seed0. Policy, current search_wdl, legal, game/ply and quantized x all round-trip; this is not a production8192-row/parallel-schedule proof.

recommended_policy_and_value_contract.policy: For the next G10 recipe-transfer preparation, use an explicitly named phase0-at-d9 policy observation, with near-close ranks and cp-quality from that identical phase0 block. Retain the existing legacy latest-phase behavior unchanged for historical runs.
recommended_policy_and_value_contract.value: Do not implicitly move root value when selecting phase0 policy. Expose and stamp its observation separately. The least-confounded policy-recipe comparison can explicitly retain legacy latest-phase-d9 searched value, identically across all recipe arms; choosing phase0 value is a separate deliberate intervention. No value convention was adopted here.
recommended_policy_and_value_contract.diagnostic_value_handling: Current latest-phase searched WDL was written unchanged in both diagnostic shards. Phase0 WDL was computed only as a counterfactual metric (114changes,maxcomponentdelta0.139746).
recommended_policy_and_value_contract.readout_scope: No evidence here ranks phase0 versus latest-phase value for playing strength, or chooses the next recipe after H20.

Fixed-depth phase0 must not be emulated with a node-budget scheme or --value-depth9.
minimal_reusable_changes.verification: Reuse this bank to show phase0 policy matches actual phase0 ranks, default legacy output stays byte-identical, and selecting policy phase0 with explicit legacy value leaves search_wdl unchanged. minimal_reusable_changes.change: Carry a compact source-qualified raw row reference and original full-history input_key alongside each surviving derived sample through the existing filter and exact shard permutation; expose it as a derivation provenance sidecar rather than reconstructing identity from game/ply or stored x. Use one shared survivor/permutation path, not independently reimplemented filtering.
minimal_reusable_changes.join: Bind source manifest/config, source_id, raw shard and physical row index; verify raw input_key against prequantization encoded x and BT4 input_key, then verify written x against the identical dtype cast. Reorder raw BT4 policy by that same reference/permutation and emit the existing derived-sidecar contract with new-source policy/fingerprint pins plus transitive raw provenance. No network re-evaluation needed.
minimal_reusable_changes.namespace: When combining runs, preserve or deterministically map source-qualified game identities through training/schedule grouping; do not let the current bare game_id column merge games from different runs.
minimal_reusable_changes.verification: Roundtrip mixed-source equal(game,ply) fixtures, input-history mismatch rejection, quantization-aware input proof, result/envelope filtering, incomplete source refusal, and exact shared shuffle/source-policy identity.
